payload.title: Platform design policy enforced for every tenant
payload.description:
What: a validator and browser checks for text floors, one image ratio on a 4px rhythm, contrast, no borders (flat fills and rounded rectangles) and colour-safe marks (never colour alone). Applies to every brand pack; a tenant cannot switch them off.
Acceptance:
Scenario: A low-contrast brand pack is refused
  Given a pack whose body text fails contrast in dark mode
  When it is validated
  Then it is rejected with the failing pair named
